sections.Profile:
"Derby Day," released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in April 1956, is a single-player, electro-mechanical pinball machine with a horse racing theme. Designed by Wayne Neyens and featuring artwork by Roy Parker, the game includes two flippers, one pop bumper, six passive bumpers, four standup targets, two slingshots, and a gobble hole.
